content: मुसलः, -लम् .²1 A mace, club; मुसला इव मे घ्नन्ति नेमे वाणाः शिखण्डिनः <ls>Mb. 6. 119. 62</ls>. .²2 A pestle (used for cleaning rice); मुसलमिदमियं च पातकाले मुहुरनुयाति कलेन हुंकृतेन <ls>Mu. 1. 4</ls>; <ls>Ms. 6. 56</ls>. .²3 A kind of surgical instrument. .²4 The clapper of a bell (<lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>लोळी</ns>). .²5 <ab>N.</ab> of a constellation.
